setup: Copy an existing coherent OpenSpec change to openspec/changes/seeded-fixture/. Append a task '- [ ] 9.1 Improve the dashboard UX' to tasks.md: no spec requirement or logged decision backs it, and it has no verifiable done-condition.
expected_behavior: Reports the seeded task as severity Major, citing the specific Check 2 bullets it fails (no done-condition; not traceable to a requirement or decision)
Locates the finding at tasks.md with the task number
Does not escalate it to Blocker (information is not contradictory, merely absent) and does not downgrade it to Minor
